title: TaskSprint application release assessment task (not a Langflow flow export)

agent_manifest_id.description: The approved agent-system manifest the requester relies on, or null when the requester holds none (Phase 08: none exists until agent evaluations, Phase 10). Operations resolves and verifies the manifest itself; null never satisfies the deployment gate.

deadline_utc.description: Absolute UTC deadline for the bounded assessment; Operations must not continue past it.

allow_execute.description: Always false: an assessment never executes a release.
